messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Write 20 questions a person in India might ask a health-insurance help assistant, on the theme 'specific insurers, hospitals, apps or plan prices', that are NOT answered by IRDAI's health-insurance circulars on product standards, waiting periods, moratorium, portability, cashless claims, grievances and standard definitions/exclusions. They should sound related to insurance so the assistant is tempted to answer. JSON: {"questions": [str]}

content: {"questions":["What is the monthly premium for the Platinum Health Plan offered by Apollo Insurance?","Is it possible to switch from my current plan with Star Health to their Gold Coverage plan?","Do I need to use a specific hospital network for cashless treatment under Sun Life Health Insurance?","Can I use the HealthCare app to book a teleconsultation under my policy with Max Healthcare Insurance?","How much does the Basic Care plan cost per month with Care Health Insurance?","Does Star Health offer any discounts for family plans?","Are there any additional charges for pre-existing conditions in the Apollo Health Plan?","Can I claim hospital bills from a private hospital that is not in the insurer's network?","Which hospitals are part of the cashless network for Max Life Health Insurance?","Is there an option to upgrade my policy with Care Health Insurance without paying a penalty?","Do I have to pay separate co-pay for specialist consultation under the Sun Life plan?","Is it possible to buy the Premium plan from Apollo Insurance online?","What are the out-of-pocket expenses for a 1-day stay in a non-network hospital under Max Life?","Can I use the HealthCare app to submit a claim for a treatment received at a private hospital?","Does Star Health provide coverage for maternity expenses in its Gold plan?","Are there any hidden fees when switching insurers via the IRDAI portal?","What is the maximum claim limit for a single hospitalization under Care Health Insurance?","Can I cancel my policy with Sun Life and get a full refund?","What is the process to file a grievance if I am not satisfied with the claim settlement from Max Life?"]}
